hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A factory and beforeInitialize hook on Robinhood Chain for permissionless fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI Uniswap v4 pool launches. Liquidity is permanently locked and priced via 30-minute TWAP oracles (RWI/WETH and WETH/USDG) targeting a $10,000 USD market cap. Pool creators can claim accrued swap fees automatically converted to native ETH.
